name: @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/desktop-shell
description: Agentic desktop runtime for Solana Agent Wallet Adapter.

scripts.tauri:dev: node scripts/check-tauri-dev.mjs && pnpm --filter @solana-agent-wallet-adapter/mcp-server build && pnpm exec tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: node scripts/check-tauri-dev.mjs && CI=true pnpm exec tauri build
scripts.icons:tauri: cd src-tauri && cargo tauri icon icons/icon.png -o icons
